title: Newton's laws of motion Module 1 Lesson 1: Horizontal Single Particle custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A constant horizontal force of magnitude $18\text{ N}$ acts on a particle of mass $4\text{ kg}$ which is on a smooth horizontal plane. Find the acceleration of the particle and the speed it attains after accelerating from rest for $3\text{ s}$.

A particle of mass $5\text{ kg}$ is pulled along a horizontal surface by a constant horizontal driving force of magnitude $26\text{ N}$. A constant resistance force of $11\text{ N}$ opposes the motion. Calculate the acceleration of the particle.

A block of mass $6\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal floor where the coefficient of friction is $\mu = 0.35$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)
Find the normal reaction force exerted by the floor on the block, and determine the magnitude of the limiting friction force.

A particle of mass $2\text{ kg}$ is projected along a rough horizontal plane with an initial speed of $8\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The coefficient of friction between the particle and the plane is $\mu = 0.4$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)
Find the deceleration of the particle and the distance it travels before coming to rest.

A particle of mass $3\text{ kg}$ is on a smooth horizontal plane. A force of magnitude $15\text{ N}$ acts on the particle at an angle of $30^\circ$ above the horizontal. Calculate the acceleration of the particle along the plane.

A particle of mass $0.8\text{ kg}$ starts from rest on a smooth horizontal table and is accelerated by a constant horizontal force of $3.6\text{ N}$. Calculate the time taken for the particle to travel a distance of $9.0\text{ m}$.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $4\text{ kg}$ is pulled along a rough horizontal floor by a constant horizontal force of magnitude $20\text{ N}$. The coefficient of friction between the block and the floor is $\mu = 0.25$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the magnitude of the frictional force acting on the block, and show that the acceleration of the block is $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that the block starts from rest, find the distance it travels in the first $4\text{ s}$ of its motion.

questions.prompt: A sled of mass $12\text{ kg}$ is pulled along a smooth horizontal frozen lake by a light rope. The tension in the rope is $30\text{ N}$ and the rope makes an angle of $25^\circ$ with the horizontal. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction force exerted by the surface on the sled, and find the acceleration of the sled.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the speed of the sled after it has travelled a distance of $6.0\text{ m}$ from rest.

questions.prompt: A crate of mass $20\text{ kg}$ is pulled along a rough horizontal floor by a constant force of magnitude $P\text{ N}$ acting at an angle of $30^\circ$ above the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between the crate and the floor is $\mu = 0.4$. The crate accelerates along the floor at $0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Show that the normal reaction force exerted by the floor on the crate is $(200 - 0.5P)\text{ N}$, and find the value of $P$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Starting from rest, the crate is pulled for $5\text{ s}$, at which instant the pulling force $P$ is removed. Find the total distance travelled by the crate from rest until it comes to rest again.

questions.prompt: A lawnmower of mass $16\text{ kg}$ is pushed along a horizontal lawn by a constant force of magnitude $50\text{ N}$ directed downwards at an angle of $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. A constant resistance force of $15\text{ N}$ opposes the motion. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction force exerted by the ground on the lawnmower, and find the acceleration of the lawnmower.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the work done by the pushing force as the lawnmower travels a distance of $8.0\text{ m}$ from rest, and calculate the speed of the lawnmower at this point.

questions.prompt: A small package of mass $2.5\text{ kg}$ is projected along a rough horizontal conveyor belt with an initial speed of $7.0\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The package travels a distance of $4.9\text{ m}$ before coming to rest. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the deceleration of the package, and deduce the value of the coefficient of friction $\mu$ between the package and the conveyor belt.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: A horizontal force of magnitude $18.5\text{ N}$ is now applied to the package when it is at rest on the conveyor belt. Find the acceleration of the package.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $8\text{ kg}$ is initially at rest on a rough horizontal surface where the coefficient of friction is $\mu = 0.2$. A pulling force of magnitude $P\text{ N}$ acts on the block at an angle of $20^\circ$ above the horizontal. Under the action of this force, the block accelerates along the surface at $1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $6\text{ s}$. The force $P$ is then suddenly removed and the block decelerates to rest under friction alone. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $P$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the speed of the block and the distance it has travelled at the instant the force $P$ is removed.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Find the additional distance travelled by the block after the force $P$ is removed before it comes to rest.

questions.prompt: A heavy parcel of mass $15\text{ kg}$ is on a rough horizontal floor where the coefficient of friction is $\mu = 0.25$. Two forces act on the parcel: a pulling force $F_1 = 40\text{ N}$ directed upwards at an angle of $30^\circ$ to the horizontal, and a horizontal pushing force $F_2 = 25\text{ N}$ acting in the same forward horizontal direction. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Show that the normal reaction force exerted by the floor on the parcel is $130\text{ N}$, and find the acceleration of the parcel.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the speed of the parcel after it has moved $5.0\text{ m}$ from rest, and calculate the total work done by the two driving forces ($F_1$ and $F_2$) over this distance.
